summary: Added --indirect-lighting-intensity to both flashlight entry points that spawn co-located ASpotLight actors. The new option defaults to 0.0, is validated as finite and non-negative, and is applied to the spawned USpotLightComponent via SetIndirectLightingIntensity, so small interiors can keep direct flashlight illumination without room-wide indirect color bounce by default.

findings.message: The option applies to both run.py and run_orbit_collection.py. In run_orbit_collection.py it covers both teleop and render workflows because both use the shared spawn_flashlight helper.

Manual reduced-indirect teleop command: conda run -n spear-env python examples/flashlight/run.py --map-path /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft --movement-speed 600 --disable-scene-lights --intensity 1500 --attenuation-radius 450 --indirect-lighting-intensity 0.

Manual reduced-indirect orbit teleop command: conda run -n spear-env python examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py --mode teleop --map-path /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft --movement-speed 600 --disable-scene-lights --intensity 1500 --attenuation-radius 450 --indirect-lighting-intensity 0 --orbit-spec-file examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json.

Manual reduced-indirect orbit render command: conda run -n spear-env python examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py --mode render --orbit-spec-file examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json --light-settings-file examples/flashlight/light_settings.example.json --output-dir examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output --indirect-lighting-intensity 0.
